purpose: Extract tileset query and native looks_like fallback responsibility from the SDL renderer; pin the loaded bundle and season and retain successful/negative results only for one terrain frame.

implementation.ownership: Terrain draw owns a stack tile_lookup_frame; renderer borrows it through a restored scope pointer. Results expose const metadata and borrow from the pinned bundle.
implementation.cache_key: Owned raw id plus category, variant, fallback depth. Bundle/season are fixed for that frame. Recursive insertions reacquire map entries; first entry is inline.
implementation.other_queries: Effects and overmap queries outside a terrain frame retain uncached resolution.
implementation.fallback_parity: Original fallback body equal after method renames and comments; same variant, season, vehicle suffix, category and depth rules.
implementation.threading_boundary: Production lookups remain on the owner thread. Native fallback reads loaded registries. Test workers use only two independent CPU-only metadata bundles; this is not live-world worker acceptance.
implementation.remaining_coupling: Metadata types are still declared in cata_tiles.h; this batch separates query implementation without claiming a backend-independent render pipeline.

speedup_claim.classification: Structural refactoring with frame query reuse; small observed render difference needs more repetitions before a stable latency claim.
speedup_claim.initial_estimate_policy: Superseded for the benefit conclusion by the fresh old-binary control. One candidate capture and two old-binary captures do not establish statistical confidence.

fixture.backend: SDL2 Tiles + sound, x11, hardware OpenGL AMD Radeon renoir
fixture.isolation: Fresh immutable origin copy for each accepted run; user source world unchanged.

cpp_format.scope: Latest actual new source files; unchanged modified renderer snippets reuse prepared format-result.json.

reused_action_phase_parser_tests.evidence: Prior accepted batch19; actual eight-family current captures validated once each.

validation.skipped: Full CI, cross-platform builds, terminal gameplay, multiplayer sessions, and normal-speed AI acceptance are outside this render/query batch.

tracy.collectors: Separate 30s Tracy-only runs; no compilation or perf during collection. Eight unwrapped families validate the fixed80 action sequence and complete presentation tail.

query_reuse.counter_scope: Includes recursive native fallback queries; cached misses count as hits.

tracy.limits: Per-frame counters include recursive fallback requests and cached misses. Nested elapsed zones overlap; input cadence sets a 9.6s floor and neither phase totals nor input-window time are whole-game FPS.

perf.settings: All process threads; cycles:u,99Hz,64 pages,32KiB DWARF. Record33s/stat35s; active input acknowledgements plus0.25s tail analyzed separately from idle collector tail.
perf.limits: Function proportions overlap and have incomplete symbol/unwind coverage. They are not absolute speedup; total sampled cycle period did not decrease. Zero sampled resolver rows do not mean zero work.

accepted-tracy.classified_differences: Player save: real wall time and unordered learned recipes; .pt matches actual wall time. Exact build-version lifecycle provenance also classified only for old/new version comparison.

accepted-perf.classified_differences: Player save: real wall time and unordered learned recipes; .pt matches actual wall time. Exact build-version lifecycle provenance also classified only for old/new version comparison.

accepted-control-tracy.classified_differences: Player save: real wall time and unordered learned recipes; .pt matches actual wall time. Exact build-version lifecycle provenance also classified only for old/new version comparison.

native_save_comparison.comparison: Active native zzip footer and compressed payload checksums verified; map/map-memory files byte-identical, object order ignored only where defined and arrays strict.
native_save_comparison.build_metadata: Only exact 2026-10-05 to2026-10-06 getVersionString fields in game_begin/game_load classified, with unchanged event counts and simulation times; counts/time/unknown version negative cases rejected. Two candidate runs and old-control/old-baseline required no version exception.

documentation_impact: Developer performance record and source ownership comments; no player or Lua authoring contract changes.
